component.name: PG Orbit
component.summary: Browse, query, and edit PostgreSQL databases

description.p: PG Orbit is a PostgreSQL client for your desktop and your phone. Browse databases, schemas, and tables, run SQL with highlighting and autocomplete, and edit rows in place.

ul.li: Schema browser for tables, views, materialized views, functions, and sequences
SQL editor with syntax highlighting, autocomplete, query parameters, history, and saved queries
Results grid with filtering, sorting, inline editing, and CSV export
Connections over SSL, SSH tunnels, and Kubernetes port forwarding
Passwords and SSH keys stay in your system keyring
On Omarchy, the app follows your desktop theme and changes with it

description.p: Browsing and read-only queries are free. Premium, a one-time purchase, unlocks writes, table design, and CSV export. An optional subscription syncs connections and saved queries across your devices.

screenshot.caption: Run SQL and browse the results
Follows your Omarchy theme, light or dark

description.p: PG Orbit is now available for Linux.

ul.li: On Omarchy, the app, SQL editor, and results grid follow the active theme and change with it
After an update, PG Orbit shows what's new in the version you just installed
Sidebar objects no longer indent far past their folder
